TL4-H1: measured by extensions/flauz-browser/test/canaries/browser-launch-runtime.drill.ts over a real Chromium (CdpEndpointHost + BrowserSessionManager; CI provisions pinned Chrome for Testing). Cold = first open over a fresh endpoint (dial + attach + first target + hardening + first navigation + first screenshot); the pre-listening Chromium spawn cost is the CI launch step, outside t0..t1 (documented in BASELINE.md).
Doctrine section 6.1. TL4-H1: warm = immediate repeat of the open path on the same warm host/transport (drill-measured, real Chromium).

PERF section 5.2 / canary C-28 A5. TL4-H1: the drill measures the SEAM SHARE of the tool path — warm (manager.navigate + manager.screenshot) p95 minus warm raw-CDP equivalents on the same endpoint. The ext-host -> renderer -> shared-process legs of the 4-process path remain WAITING-ON-LANE F (booted workbench driver; the documented residue, same class as the session-battery residue). The seam share is the product-controlled portion of the 250ms; citing it as the full-path number is dishonest.

TL4-H1: measured on the REAL fabric seam (bootstrapFabric + registry + providerFor -> provideLanguageModelChatInformation) with the vendor endpoint a LOCAL mock (the flauz-mock echo vendor and an openai-compat provider against a local OpenAI-shape HTTP server — inference is excluded by contract). ready = switch command -> new provider model list available (the interactive path). Live-vendor recalibration stays with TL2-H1 (live-provider verification).
